steps.en: Clone the repo and copy the env template; put provider keys or user_provided in .env
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，复制 env 模板，填好服务商 key
启动 compose 整套服务

steps.en: Brings up the app with MongoDB, Meilisearch, pgvector and the RAG API, serving on port 3080
steps.zh: 拉起应用及 MongoDB、搜索、向量库和 RAG 服务

steps.en: Declare extra endpoints such as Ollama or OpenRouter in librechat.yaml
steps.zh: 在 librechat.yaml 里声明 Ollama 等额外端点

steps.en: Users sign up or log in, pick a model from the menu, and chat
steps.zh: 用户注册或登录，在菜单里挑模型开聊

steps.en: Routes each message to the chosen provider, streams the reply, and saves it per user
steps.zh: 把每条消息转给所选服务商，流式返回，并按用户存档

value.en: One logged-in, searchable chat workspace over every provider, with history and files kept on your servers
value.zh: 一个统一登录、可搜索的聊天工作台接入所有服务商，历史和文件都留在自己服务器上

sources: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/local/docker (git clone https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat.git; cp .env.example .env; docker compose up -d; open http://localhost:3080; mount librechat.yaml via docker-compose.override.yml for custom endpoints)
docker-compose.yml @ main 2026-10-08 (services api, admin-panel, mongodb, meilisearch, vectordb pgvector, rag_api)
README.md @ main 2026-10-08 (custom endpoints incl. Ollama and OpenRouter; multi-user auth with OAuth2, LDAP, email login)
